name: 97060 · Troutdale, OR
findings: ZIP 97060 (Troutdale) has 33 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97060 (Troutdale) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 97060 (Troutdale) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 52% of the typical level).
